svg.title: BACKEND_DEVELOPER: complete deterministic automaton
svg.desc: One complete outgoing-transition panel per source state. Identical names denote the same state. All input symbols have one destination. The rejecting sink is explicit.
svg.text: Complete DFA: 19 states · 13 symbols · 247 transition triples · no epsilon transitions.
Every panel lists all outgoing transitions. Commas separate alternative input symbols on one edge.
Identical names denote the same state. Arrow into q0 = start. Double circle = accepting.
q_dead is the rejecting sink: all its symbols return to q_dead. Missing or out-of-order groups enter q_dead.
Backend memory: Lm reads languages; Wm has read frameworks but no compatible pair yet.
m records compatible frameworks: bit 1 = DJANGO; bit 2 = NODE_JS; bit 4 = SPRING_BOOT.
Examples: L3/W3 admit DJANGO or NODE_JS; L7 admits all three. W7 is unreachable.
pair_seen = compatible pair; q3 = database; q4 = REST_API; qf = GIT.
